title: AI-assisted preparation prompts
body: Tool-agnostic prompts. AI drafts; a named human reviews facts, sharing, and capability claims before anything is used or sent.

lines.label: Authorized inputs
lines.text: Accepted decisions, conditions, action owners and shareable asset links.

lines.label: Prompt
lines.text: Draft separate customer-facing recap and internal handoff. Customer version contains only agreed outcomes, priorities, decisions, open assumptions and actions; exclude private qualification scores, internal policy and restricted content. Flag proposed dates pending acceptance. Do not send.

lines.label: Required output
lines.text: Recap; MAP updates; delivery/value handoff; access check.

lines.label: Human review
lines.text: Human communication owner confirms accuracy, recipients and access before sending.
